name: bilibili-learning-version
description: BiliBili Learning Version - a focused Windows learning client for Bilibili content.
author: BiliBili Learning Version

scripts.package:win: pnpm build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64
scripts.package:dir: pnpm build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win dir --x64
scripts.publish:win: pnpm build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish always
